source.titleEnglishInternal: Read the Hotel's Allergen Chart Before the Buffet
source.objectiveEnglishInternal: Read a printed allergen chart with staff, flag what is out of date, and explain what to verify before eating.
source.speakingEnglishInternal: You are reading the hotel's allergen chart with the AI, host Renzo, for your partner Elif, who is allergic to sesame: go through each bread and spread, ask clear questions, and say what to check using antes de / después de + infinitive and hay que.

grammarInternal.focus: Antes de / después de + infinitive; hay que (antes de servirte, hay que preguntar; la tabla dice que contiene sésamo)

examples.es: Antes de probar el pan, hay que leer la etiqueta.
examples.en: Before trying the bread, you have to read the label.

examples.es: Después de hablar con cocina, Renzo nos confirma los ingredientes.
examples.en: After talking to the kitchen, Renzo will confirm the ingredients for us.

readerVerbExamplesInternal.target: Renzo confirma los ingredientes con el jefe de cocina.
readerVerbExamplesInternal.native: Renzo confirms the ingredients with the head chef.

readerVerbExamplesInternal.target: Yo reviso cada etiqueta antes del desayuno.
readerVerbExamplesInternal.native: I check each label before breakfast.

readerVerbExamplesInternal.target: Leo la tabla de alérgenos con Renzo.
readerVerbExamplesInternal.native: I read the allergen chart with Renzo.

readerVerbExamplesInternal.target: El pan de molde contiene ajonjolí.
Le pido la ficha técnica al jefe de cocina.
readerVerbExamplesInternal.native: I ask the head chef for the spec sheet.

archivedDraft.scene: At a hotel breakfast buffet, one guest helps a companion with a sesame allergy ask the host about an old chart and a new bread supplier.

sourceCards.sourceNoteInternal: Common word in Peru; labels may say sésamo.
Labels say puede contener trazas de: may contain traces of.

sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: ペルーのパン・フランセス

sourceCards.sourceNoteInternal: Use it only as the prescribing doctor instructed.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: エピネフリン自己注射器

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Antes de servirte nada, hay que confirmar la tabla con Renzo.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Before you serve yourself anything, we need to confirm the chart with Renzo.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 何か取る前に、レンソとこの表の内容を確認しなきゃ。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Before you serve yourself anything, we need to confirm the chart with Renzo.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Disculpe, ¿de qué fecha es esta tabla de alérgenos?
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Excuse me, what date is this allergen chart from?
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: すみません、このアレルゲン一覧表はいつの日付のものですか。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Excuse me, what date is this allergen chart from?

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: La tabla dice que el pan francés no contiene ajonjolí.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: The chart says the French roll doesn't contain sesame.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: この表では、パン・フランセスにごまは入っていないと書いてあります。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: The chart says the French roll doesn't contain sesame.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: ¿Podría pedirle la etiqueta del proveedor al jefe de cocina?
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Could you ask the head chef for the supplier's label?
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 料理長に供給業者のラベルを取り寄せてもらえますか。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Could you ask the head chef for the supplier's label?

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Si la tabla no está actualizada, hay que revisar cada etiqueta.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: If the chart isn't up to date, we need to check each label.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: この表が最新でないなら、ラベルを一つずつ確認する必要があります。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: If the chart isn't up to date, we need to check each label.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Después de leer la etiqueta, te digo qué puedes comer.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: After reading the label, I'll tell you what you can eat.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: ラベルを読んだら、何を食べられるか伝えるね。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: After reading the label, I'll tell you what you can eat.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Mi pareja tiene alergia al ajonjolí, incluso a las trazas.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: My partner is allergic to sesame, even to traces.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 私のパートナーはごまにアレルギーがあり、微量のごまにも反応します。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: My partner is allergic to sesame, even to traces.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Mejor no comas nada sin confirmarlo primero.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Better not eat anything without confirming it first.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 確認できるまでは何も食べないほうがいいよ。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Better not eat anything without confirming it first.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator with source dialogue
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: En el comedor de un hotel de Miraflores, en Lima, Elif y yo llegamos temprano al bufé del desayuno.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: In the dining room of a hotel in Miraflores, in Lima, Elif and I arrive early for the breakfast buffet.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: リマのミラフローレス地区にあるホテルの食堂に、エリフと私は朝早く朝食ビュッフェへ来た。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: In the dining room of a hotel in Miraflores, in Lima, Elif and I arrive early for the breakfast buffet.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator with source dialogue
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Yo le digo a Elif: Antes de servirte nada, hay que confirmar la tabla con Renzo.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: I tell Elif: Before you serve yourself anything, we need to confirm the chart with Renzo.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 私はエリフに言う。「何か取る前に、レンソとこの表の内容を確認しなきゃ。」
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: I tell Elif: Before you serve yourself anything, we need to confirm the chart with Renzo.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator with source dialogue
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Renzo, el anfitrión, nos trae la tabla de alérgenos impresa y la pone sobre la mesa.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Renzo, the host, brings us the printed allergen chart and puts it on the table.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 案内係のレンソが印刷されたアレルゲン一覧表を持ってきて、テーブルに置く。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Renzo, the host, brings us the printed allergen chart and puts it on the table.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator with source dialogue
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Le explico a Renzo: Mi pareja tiene alergia al ajonjolí, incluso a las trazas.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: I explain to Renzo: My partner is allergic to sesame, even to traces.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 私はレンソに説明する。「私のパートナーはごまにアレルギーがあり、微量のごまにも反応します。」
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: I explain to Renzo: My partner is allergic to sesame, even to traces.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator with source dialogue
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Después de leer la primera columna, le pregunto: Disculpe, ¿de qué fecha es esta tabla de alérgenos?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: After reading the first column, I ask him: Excuse me, what date is this allergen chart from?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 最初の列を読んでから、私は彼に尋ねる。「すみません、このアレルゲン一覧表はいつの日付のものですか。」
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: After reading the first column, I ask him: Excuse me, what date is this allergen chart from?

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator with source dialogue
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Renzo señala la fecha de actualización del 3 de marzo, pero el hotel tiene un proveedor nuevo de pan desde septiembre.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Renzo points to the date last updated, March 3, but the hotel has had a new bread supplier since September.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: レンソは最終更新日が3月3日だと指さす。しかしホテルは9月から新しいパンの供給業者を使っている。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Renzo points to the date last updated, March 3, but the hotel has had a new bread supplier since September.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator with source dialogue
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Leo en voz alta: La tabla dice que el pan francés no contiene ajonjolí.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: I read aloud: The chart says the French roll doesn't contain sesame.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 私は声に出して読む。「この表では、パン・フランセスにごまは入っていないと書いてあります。」
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: I read aloud: The chart says the French roll doesn't contain sesame.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator with source dialogue
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Pero el pan de molde del nuevo proveedor tiene semillas por encima, y la tabla no dice nada de eso.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: But the sliced bread from the new supplier has seeds on top, and the chart says nothing about that.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: しかし、新しい供給業者の食パンには表面に種がついていて、表にはそのことが何も書かれていない。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: But the sliced bread from the new supplier has seeds on top, and the chart says nothing about that.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator with source dialogue
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Le digo a Renzo: Si la tabla no está actualizada, hay que revisar cada etiqueta.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: I tell Renzo: If the chart isn't up to date, we need to check each label.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 私はレンソに言う。「この表が最新でないなら、ラベルを一つずつ確認する必要があります。」
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: I tell Renzo: If the chart isn't up to date, we need to check each label.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator with source dialogue
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Luego le pregunto: ¿Podría pedirle la etiqueta del proveedor al jefe de cocina?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Then I ask him: Could you ask the head chef for the supplier's label?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: それから彼に尋ねる。「料理長に供給業者のラベルを取り寄せてもらえますか。」
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Then I ask him: Could you ask the head chef for the supplier's label?

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator with source dialogue
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Mientras Renzo va a la cocina, le digo a Elif: Después de leer la etiqueta, te digo qué puedes comer.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: While Renzo goes to the kitchen, I tell Elif: After reading the label, I'll tell you what you can eat.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: レンソが厨房へ行っている間、私はエリフに言う。「ラベルを読んだら、何を食べられるか伝えるね。」
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: While Renzo goes to the kitchen, I tell Elif: After reading the label, I'll tell you what you can eat.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator with source dialogue
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Después de hablar con el jefe de cocina, Renzo regresa con la ficha técnica del pan de molde y la etiqueta del pan francés.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: After talking to the head chef, Renzo comes back with the spec sheet for the sliced bread and the label for the French roll.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 料理長と話した後、レンソは食パンの製品仕様書とパン・フランセスのラベルを持って戻る。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: After talking to the head chef, Renzo comes back with the spec sheet for the sliced bread and the label for the French roll.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator with source dialogue
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: La ficha técnica confirma que las semillas del pan de molde son de ajonjolí.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: The spec sheet confirms that the seeds on the sliced bread are sesame.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 製品仕様書で、食パンの表面の種がごまだと確認できる。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: The spec sheet confirms that the seeds on the sliced bread are sesame.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator with source dialogue
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: La etiqueta del pan francés dice: Puede contener trazas de ajonjolí.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: The French roll's label says: May contain traces of sesame.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: パン・フランセスのラベルには「微量のごまを含む可能性があります」と書いてある。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: The French roll's label says: May contain traces of sesame.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator with source dialogue
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Entonces le digo a Elif: Mejor no comas nada sin confirmarlo primero.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: So I tell Elif: Better not eat anything without confirming it first.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: そこで私はエリフに言う。「確認できるまでは何も食べないほうがいいよ。」
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: So I tell Elif: Better not eat anything without confirming it first.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator with source dialogue
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Renzo explica que el jefe de cocina puede preparar huevos revueltos con utensilios separados, solo con huevo, sal y mantequilla.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Renzo explains that the head chef can make scrambled eggs with separate utensils, with only egg, salt and butter.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: レンソによると、料理長は別々の調理器具を使い、卵、塩、バターだけでスクランブルエッグを作ることができる。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Renzo explains that the head chef can make scrambled eggs with separate utensils, with only egg, salt and butter.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator with source dialogue
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Antes de comer, Elif revisa que tiene su autoinyector de epinefrina en el bolso.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Before eating, Elif checks that she has her epinephrine auto-injector in her bag.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 食べる前に、エリフはエピネフリン自己注射器がバッグに入っているか確認する。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Before eating, Elif checks that she has her epinephrine auto-injector in her bag.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator with source dialogue
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Le explico a Renzo que, si Elif tiene una reacción alérgica, hay que usar el autoinyector como indicó su médico y llamar a una ambulancia.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: I explain to Renzo that if Elif has an allergic reaction, we have to use the auto-injector as her doctor instructed and call an ambulance.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 私はレンソに、エリフにアレルギー反応が出た場合は、医師の指示どおりに自己注射器を使い、救急車を呼ぶ必要があると説明する。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: I explain to Renzo that if Elif has an allergic reaction, we have to use the auto-injector as her doctor instructed and call an ambulance.

japaneseSpecificFocusCandidate: Use 〜する前に, 〜した後で and 〜する必要がある to compare a hotel's allergen chart with current supplier labels and explain checks before eating.
speakingGoalInternal: You are reading the hotel's allergen chart with the AI, host Renzo, for your partner Elif, who is allergic to sesame: go through each bread and spread, ask clear questions, and say what to check using antes de / después de + infinitive and hay que.
speakingGoalJapaneseDraft: ごまにアレルギーのあるパートナー、エリフのために、ホテルの案内係レンソと印刷されたアレルゲン一覧表を確認する。パンとスプレッドを一品ずつ尋ね、食べる前に何を確かめる必要があるか説明する。
sourceConflictInternal: Current Spanish Master 4 has Elif and Renzo at a Miraflores, Lima hotel buffet, 23 cards and 18 Reader turns; the archive has 17 cards and eleven turns and is not a source-equivalent substitute. March 3 allergen chart predates a September bread-supplier change: sliced-bread seeds are sesame and the pan francés label says it may contain traces. The head chef offers separately prepared eggs with egg, salt and butter, but source does not state a safety approval. Elif checks an epinephrine auto-injector; doctor-directed use and calling an ambulance are source facts.

oldReaderPositionPlan.oldEnglish: Here is the breakfast allergen chart.
oldReaderPositionPlan.disposition: retire from candidate only; retain archive; no saved-item migration

oldReaderPositionPlan.oldEnglish: When was this chart last updated?
oldReaderPositionPlan.disposition: retire from candidate only; retain archive; no saved-item migration

oldReaderPositionPlan.oldEnglish: It was updated in March. Our bread supplier changed last month.
oldReaderPositionPlan.disposition: retire from candidate only; retain archive; no saved-item migration

oldReaderPositionPlan.oldEnglish: Then I would like to check whether the bread information is current.
oldReaderPositionPlan.disposition: retire from candidate only; retain archive; no saved-item migration

oldReaderPositionPlan.oldEnglish: I will check the current label and specification with the kitchen. I will also ask about utensils.
oldReaderPositionPlan.disposition: retire from candidate only; retain archive; no saved-item migration

oldReaderPositionPlan.oldEnglish: I will wait without eating until the checks are complete.
oldReaderPositionPlan.disposition: retire from candidate only; retain archive; no saved-item migration

oldReaderPositionPlan.oldEnglish: The kitchen responded, but we cannot verify the cross-contact risk.
oldReaderPositionPlan.disposition: retire from candidate only; retain archive; no saved-item migration

oldReaderPositionPlan.oldEnglish: Understood. We will not choose food that cannot be verified.
oldReaderPositionPlan.disposition: retire from candidate only; retain archive; no saved-item migration

oldReaderPositionPlan.oldEnglish: Let's ask the appropriate staff member about other options.

reviewQuestionsInternal: パン・フランセスというペルーの朝食用ロールパン名を、日本語の食材表示でどう説明するか。
ごまの微量混入を示す表示文言と、エリフの微量への反応の日本語が適切か。
ごまの種がある食パンと、微量を含む可能性のあるパン・フランセスを混同していないか。
旧3月3日付の表と9月からの新供給業者という時系列を維持できているか。
卵・塩・バターだけのスクランブルエッグを「安全」と推断せず、別々の調理器具という出典事実だけにとどめたか。
エピネフリン自己注射器、医師の指示、救急車という臨床語の正確さ。
レンソへの丁寧語とエリフへの親しい言い方の差。
スペイン語の antes de／después de／hay que に対応する日本語の文法目標は別途設計が必要。
